definitions.explanation: A person who watches events unfold without getting involved. Often carries a negative nuance of passivity or indifference.

examples.japanese: {傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧な。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He always takes the position of an onlooker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっていた→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many onlookers had gathered at the scene of the accident.

notes:
Describes someone who watches a situation without participating or intervening. Unlike neutral words for spectator, {傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ} often implies a moral judgment — the person could or should act but chooses not to.

FORMS:
{傍|ぼう} (beside) + {観|かん} (watch) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to remain a bystander
- {傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: the stance of an onlooker
- {傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: the bystander effect
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}: merely a spectator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見物人|けんぶつにん}→見物人：27722_kenbutsunin⟧: spectator, sightseer — neutral, used for entertainment or events
- ⟦{野次馬|やじうま}→野次馬：16403_yajiuma⟧: rubbernecker — curious onlooker drawn to incidents, more colloquial
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧: audience, spectator — specifically for shows, sports, and performances
